chunks: And the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم used to say in his supplication:

"O Allah, I seek refuge in You from a child who becomes a master over me, from wealth that becomes loss upon me, from a wife who makes me gray before the time of my grayness, and from a deceitful close friend whose eyes see me while his heart watches for my harm. If he sees good, he buries it, and if he sees evil, he spreads it. And I seek refuge in You from stomach pain, [and from those who are] deaf: when they hear good by which I am mentioned, and if I am mentioned with evil in their presence, they listen."

key_terms.خَلِيلٍ: an intimate friend or close companion
key_terms.ٱللَّهُمَّ: O Allah; the opening invocation of du'a

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم seek refuge from in his supplication?
ai.summary: This hadith records a supplication of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم seeking refuge in Allah from harmful family, wealth, illness, and treacherous companionship. It highlights moral and social harms that can afflict a person and teaches turning to Allah through du'a for protection from them.
